Name: Statue Of Fortune
Author: keithmfrench
Description:
Updated to 1.6.15

Do you have so many NPC that the Statue of Endless Fortune always gives birthday gifts?
Frustrated that you spend $1,000,000 on a birthday present machine?
The Statue of Fortune is for you. It adds a statue that only gives the good stuff. (Diamonds, Gold bars, Iridium bars, and Omni Geodes)

Can be bought from Krobus for $1,000,000
This is an added machine, you can still buy the "Statue of Endless Fortune" if you want.

Compliments [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7532]Statue of Generosity[/url] perfectly.

Manifest.Name: Statue of Fortune
Manifest.Description: Purchase a statue which produces ore bars each morning.
